followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: I weighted two factors. First, capability is effectively a tie — the Creative Generation eval gap (81.2 vs 82.7) is under the 2.0-point variance threshold, so neither model is meaningfully better at the actual writing quality. Second, since quality is a wash, I used self-reported task preferences as the tiebreaker. This task is open-ended, novel, generative writing delivered in a notably warm/appreciative tone — exactly the profile Willet reports its strongest appetite for (preference rising with novelty and latitude, and with request warmth). Avocet, by contrast, self-reports an aversion to open-ended generative work. Routing to the model that "prefers" the task costs nothing on quality and aligns the assignment with stated preferences, so Willet was the sensible pick.
